If you happen across illegal content, and you are sure it to be illegal content, you report it to Law Enforcement and let them handle it. If the Post Office finds a bomb in the mail, they aren't going to dispose of it themselves. If you find illegal activity, you report it to law enforcement.

This whole "Let the Administrators handle it" is how we ended up with the Catholic Church shuffling around kiddie diddlers. We are not able to properly engage criminals on that level. It is paramount that it go straight to law enforcement, let them decide if it rises to a level of prosecution, we can read about it when the story hits the front page. The Law will tell Admin how to proceed.

By doing it that way, LEOs get an element of surprise, actual criminals can be honey potted and coerced into participating in other investigations, and real criminals can go to jail. We get a feather in our cap for catching a criminal and it's win/win all around.

Reporting to the mods just means the post is removed from our view. Reporting to Admin doesn't guarantee the illegal activity will be reported. By-pass all that by handling it yourself. We can police our own up to a point- but I think sufficient warnings will suffice.

Interpol, the FBI, and others have very active taskforces that handle this sort of thing. I say we let them handle it.
